$comment: The four festival events, in journey order (SFC -> Under the Stars -> Educational Screening -> Main Screening). `id` is used in films/schedule; `theme` is the colour theme (sfc | uts | main | base). `title` lines build the big display title; `script` (optional) is a word that is genuinely part of the name, drawn in script between the lines (e.g. Under *the* Stars). Media keys refer to media.json.

items.name: Short Film Competition
title: Short Film
Competition
items.summary: Showcases emerging Indonesian filmmakers, highlighting original stories and fresh creative voices.
description: The Short Film Competition showcases emerging Indonesian filmmakers, highlighting original stories and fresh creative voices.
Submission and screening details for the 21st edition will be announced soon.
